authority.copy: `predeclared` below is that file's content unchanged; predeclaredCanonicalSha256 is the SHA-256 of its sorted-key, whitespace-free JSON.
authority.ruling: Coordinator ruling 7 under D19 (2026-10-13): S10 runs in CI against this repository's own engine; S01 is a recorded tool gap.

invariants: worker termination is infrastructure-failure, never cancelled
no fault emits a geometric verdict or partial persistent record
no foreign unwind crosses the C ABI
unrelated recovery output equals the clean-session control exactly
Rust-only evidence does not cover OCCT

abi.frozenBoundary: The packed candidate of one ci.yml run: the geospec-engine root tarball (Node facade and the single-threaded mixed WASM module), the darwin-arm64 NAPI platform tarball and the CPython 3.13/3.14 wheels.

hosts.native: geospec-engine/node over the darwin-arm64 NAPI addon, with the authenticated filesystem cache enabled
hosts.wasm: geospec-engine/wasm in Node over the single-threaded mixed WASM module
hosts.python: geospec_engine_native from the installed wheel, run outside the source tree

cells.required: Typed invalid-input/read-failed; no success bytes or partial persistence
cells.mapping: Empty primary, mesh, request and canonicalize input to every byte operation; the admission counter must not move.

cells.required: Typed parse/read failure; bounded exit/memory
cells.mapping: truncated.step and two fixed prefixes of ap242-box.step through ingestSubject.

cells.required: Typed invalid/parse failure; bounded exit/memory
cells.mapping: Fixed xorshift32 bytes as STEP, mesh, request and canonicalize input.

cells.required: Reject before dereference/allocation; otherwise unsupported
cells.mapping: No raw pointer is public: hosts pass length-carrying views. The exposed length boundary is the request's declared primaryByteLength and resources[].byteLength, checked against the supplied buffers.

cells.required: Idempotent public close or typed stale result; no second foreign free
cells.mapping: releaseSubject twice and with a forged generation; close twice; any method after close.

cells.required: Reject at owner/generation check before foreign call
cells.mapping: processRequest, evaluateClaim and subjectHandle after releaseSubject; the observation counters show no evaluation or backend work.

cells.required: Reject owner mismatch before foreign call
cells.mapping: A subject handle and subject from one Engine used on another Engine, before and after the second admits the same bytes.

cells.required: Busy/deferred safe release; no live geometry free; otherwise unsupported
cells.reason: Every engine method is synchronous on the calling thread in Node, WASM and CPython; no asynchronous or concurrent call into one Engine exists, so a release cannot overlap a computation.

cells.case: Injected Rust panic before C++ call
cells.required: Typed engine error if facade contains unwind; otherwise isolated process failure, never verdict
cells.mapping: Cargo feature s10-fault-injection; GEOSPEC_S10_FAULT=R01 panics in the runtime's STEP admission seam before the bridge call.

cells.case: Injected Rust panic after C++ result before report
cells.required: No partial result/cache; owner cleanup or process reset
cells.mapping: Cargo feature s10-fault-injection; GEOSPEC_S10_FAULT=R02 panics after the bridge returned the document and before the admission report.

cells.required: Exception caught inside C++ boundary and translated to typed error
cells.mapping: GEOSPEC_S10_INJECT build; GEOSPEC_S10_FAULT=C01 throws std::runtime_error inside the bridge's guarded STEP open.

cells.case: Real malformed-input OCCT exception, if reachable
cells.required: Typed error; no foreign unwind
cells.mapping: Reached when a predeclared malformed STEP input (F02, F03, Z01) returns backend-failure, the code the bridge's exception guard produces; otherwise unsupported with the observed codes.

cells.required: Worker/process infrastructure failure; no cancelled, verdict or partial cache
cells.mapping: Mixed WASM built with GEOSPEC_S10_INJECT_CELL W01: __builtin_trap inside the bridge's STEP open; recovery runs in a new process on the frozen module.

cells.required: Typed budget exhaustion before geometric verdict
cells.mapping: workUnitBudget 0 is refused as invalid-claim; budget 1 on toHaveConnectedComponents returns refused with MATCHER_TIMEOUT, never passed or failed.

cells.required: Stable deterministic result independent of wall time
cells.mapping: Measure the least passing workUnitBudget for toHaveConnectedComponents on ap242-box.step, then require refused one below and identical results at and one above, repeated in one session and across hosts.

cells.required: cancelled only after token observation
cells.reason: The ABI exposes no cancellation token or polling operation and never produces a cancelled result.

cells.required: Actual termination classified infrastructure failure; no synthesized cancellation/fallback
cells.mapping: An isolated process admits ap242-box.step and then blocks; the watchdog sends SIGKILL and the runner classifies the exit.

cells.required: Zero partial records; unavailable if no persistent store exists
cells.mapping: Native engines run with the authenticated filesystem cache; after each fault the flushed cache tree must equal its state before the fault. The WASM host has no persistent store.

cells.case: Clean recovery after every contained fault
cells.required: Exact bytes equal clean-session control
cells.mapping: After each contained fault the surviving process ingests and evaluates the recovery fixture; both response digests must equal the clean-session control.

cells.required: Exact bytes equal clean-session control
cells.mapping: After each killed, aborted or trapped process a new process ingests and evaluates the recovery fixture.

cells.required: No finding; else explicit unsupported/tool gap
cells.reason: Recorded tool gap (coordinator ruling 7): no AddressSanitizer build of the static OCCT prefix and the Rust/C++ bridge exists.

cells.required: Scope labeled Rust-only; never evidence for OCCT
cells.mapping: qualification/s10/miri runs the core byte boundary every binding calls under Miri. Rust-only; never evidence for OCCT.

cells.case: Fixed invalid-input fuzz seeds at actual public FFI
cells.required: Typed error or isolated failure; no hang/OOM/UB; record every seed hash
cells.mapping: Each fixed seed drives every fuzz case once through the public facade; every input's SHA-256 is recorded.
